messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'eu-central-3' utilization 98% and request queue growth detected. p95 latency 3.2s -> 15s in 5m. error rate 502s increasing.
Aisha (oncall): seeing dashboard, acknowledged. I'm paged.
Aisha (oncall): @Lena can you join? Looks like autoscaler isn't adding new nodes.
Lena (sre): on it. checking controller logs.
Ops Pager: On-call handover ping: @Aisha is current oncall. Escalation path: @Jorge then @Priya.
Jorge (infra): I can check quota and instance creation errors. Any quota spikes in cloud?
Aisha (oncall): not yet clear. customer-impact: a few customers reporting timeouts/partial responses. slack thread started.
Priya (eng-runtime): quick note: fallback routing to quantized model is enabled but not triggering because routing rules require 'capacity_ok'.
Lena (sre): controller logs: "InstanceCreationFailed: rate limit exceeded" repeatedly from provisioner. Autoscaler backoff at 2m.
Lena (sre): paste:
```
2026-03-14T21:03:10Z provisioner: createNode failed status=429 body="QuotaExceeded"
2026-03-14T21:03:12Z autoscaler: leader lost lease, retrying
```
Jorge (infra): cloud quotas look fine per API, but we're hitting per-region instance creation rate limit (burst cap). Antrag open with cloud support, ETA unknown.
Aisha (oncall): mitigation options? Prioritize critical customers? Route traffic to dedicated pools?
Priya (eng-runtime): we can temporarily enable "allow_burst_provisioning" in provisioner config to bypass soft rate limit for 10m. Requires controller restart. Risk: higher cost but reduces queue.
Lena (sre): alternative: enable binary fallback to smaller model variants (gpt-medium-q4) for non-enterprise routes. That reduces GPU memory and allows more concurrent slots.
Jorge (infra): I can patch provisioner to stagger creation across zones to lower per-zone burst. Rolling patch coming.
Aisha (oncall): implement plan: 1) enable model-variant fallback for low-tier routes (Priya) 2) temp allow_burst_provisioning (Jorge) 3) pause non-critical background batch jobs (Lena). I'll notify customers.
Priya (eng-runtime): starting feature flag rollout: /api/flags/fallback-variant -> ON for routes with tag=low-priority. Rolling 30s.
Priya (eng-runtime): ...flag ON. telemetry shows 25% of requests dropped to smaller models. effective p95 dropping from 15s -> 6.1s for those routes.
Lena (sre): pausing background jobs: sent kill to batch queue controllers. memory freed.
Jorge (infra): patch deployed to provisioner, enabling staggered creates. monitoring instance creation rate.
incident-bot: SYSTEM: Provisioner config updated by Jorge at 1765432228.
Aisha (oncall): customer update draft: "We observed a regional GPU provisioning disruption causing elevated latencies and timeouts for some requests. We have applied mitigations and are restoring capacity. We'll post a postmortem if impact persists." Approve?
Lena (sre): approve. add note about automatic fallback rules.
Priya (eng-runtime): p95 now 1.8s overall, p99 7.2s. Error rate trending down.
Aisha (oncall): handing off to night-shift @night-shift in 30m. log root cause action items: - monitor cloud rate-limit ticket - add autoscaler fallback to force model-variant in events of scale stall - add alert for instance-creation-429.
night-shift: acked. I'll watch the dashboard and escalate if >2x current errors.
Aisha (oncall): closing live mitigation. will open incident-tracker and link postmortem.
